explanation: Abbreviation for the Book of Proverbs, a collection of proverbs and wisdom literature in the Bible.
The ability to use knowledge and experience in a reasonable and prudent way to make good decisions.
The ability to comprehend and evaluate situations and problems in an intelligent and insightful manner.
Training or correction aimed at teaching and improving behavior.
A lack of willingness or energy to work, often viewed as a negative trait.
A wet, muddy area with poor drainage, frequently used as a metaphor for difficult or dangerous situations.
An animal that hunts and eats other animals, used as a metaphor for people who exploit and harm others.
A false statement or story intended to deceive or mislead.
The quality of being dishonest, untrustworthy, or inauthentic.
A person or group opposed or hostile toward another; an adversary.
